mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at clear skies and a comfortable 65 degrees out near Reddan Soccer Park, with the first quarter moon visible tonight.

The city has been busy with infrastructure updates, including the Mark Drive reconstruction project which involves utility and road improvements, and ongoing street rehabilitation projects like Gateway Pass and Enterprise Drive to ensure our transit network remains safe and functional.

It is a busy week for Verona, with the Epic User Group Meeting and Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today, plus don't forget the Concerts in the Park at Century School Park tonight, and you can look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company starting tomorrow.

Looking at the police department weekly report, on August 15, officers responded to a call regarding a missing 7-year-old child, who was safely located and reunited with their parents shortly after the report was made.
Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM to serve you the delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch flavor of the day, and you can look forward to Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie tomorrow.
